name: Arrow
additionalInfo: {"arrow":true,"entries":["Arrows are used with a weapon that has the ammunition property to make a ranged attack. additionalInfo: {"entries":["A metal gong, traditionally made from a shield, particularly the shield of an enemy. Both goblins and dwarves make and play wargongs, their sound echoing through tunnels in the Underdark."]}

name: Yklwa
additionalInfo: {"weaponCategory":"simple","property":["T"],"range":"10\/30","dmg1":"1d8","dmgType":"P","weapon":true,"entries":["A yklwa (pronounced YICK-ul-wah) is a simple melee weapon that is the traditional weapon of Chultan warriors. name: Zulkoon
additionalInfo: {"entries":["A complex pump organ that originated with the zulkirs of Thay, who use it in the casting of their spells. It is considered to have a dramatic, but sinister, sound."]}
